cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(reverie_signal_admission_state C ASM)
find_package(DynamoRIO REQUIRED)
add_library(signal_admission_state_client SHARED client.c clobber.S)
configure_DynamoRIO_client(signal_admission_state_client)
use_DynamoRIO_extension(signal_admission_state_client drmgr)
target_compile_options(signal_admission_state_client PRIVATE -Werror=implicit-function-declaration)
add_executable(signal_admission_state_guest guest.c probe.S clobber.S)
target_compile_options(signal_admission_state_guest PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fno-stack-protector)
target_link_options(signal_admission_state_guest PRIVATE -rdynamic)
target_link_libraries(signal_admission_state_guest PRIVATE pthread)
add_library(signal_admission_sigpipe_client SHARED sigpipe_client.c)
configure_DynamoRIO_client(signal_admission_sigpipe_client)
use_DynamoRIO_extension(signal_admission_sigpipe_client drmgr)
target_compile_options(signal_admission_sigpipe_client PRIVATE -Werror=implicit-function-declaration)
add_executable(signal_admission_sigpipe_guest sigpipe_guest.c)
target_compile_options(signal_admission_sigpipe_guest PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
